text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: billing/metering — sudden token emit spike + ledger mismatch in eu-west-1. Several customers triggered overage flags. Paging on-call.

jordan (on-call): Acknowledged. Pulling logs now. Anyone seeing linked deploys?

aliya (billing): We're getting alerts from billing pipeline: delta between ingest and settle ~+18%. Customers with daily caps hit flags.

mike (infra): No deploys in the last 2 hours. Looks like emitter replay amplified by retry storm. KV cache eviction happened ~1718505800.

jordan (on-call): Quick mitigation: throttling emitter retries and enable transient dedupe on ingest. Executing runbook cmd: `./ops/tools/throttle_emitter --region eu-west-1 --rate 50%`

opsbot: Command accepted, throttling at 50% for eu-west-1.

jordan (on-call): Running quick query to confirm top offenders:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS recent_tokens
FROM token_emits
WHERE ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY recent_tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

aliya (billing): Got the list — 23 customers above expected. Opening billing reconciliation ticket and pausing automated overage emails for the next 30m to avoid noisy alerts.

sarah (support): I'll draft a customer note: short, we saw transient billing noise, investigating, will reconcile charges. Sending to affected accounts now.

mike (infra): Also enabling fallback aggregator to rebuild counts from raw events: `agg-rebuild --from 1718505600 --to now --dry-run` then apply. Might take ~20-40m.

jordan (on-call): Good. After rebuild we'll compare to settled ledger and run a backfill if needed. For now keep throttles and pause overage emails.

aliya (billing): Marking high priority for finance reconciliation. I'll coordinate credits if backfill shows overcount.

incident-bot: Note: SLO impact minimal (latency OK), billing visibility degraded for ~25m.

jordan (on-call): Will hold handoff at 1718506740 with on-call for next shift. If anyone sees new spike react @jordan.

sarah (support): Customer messages sent. Adding Slack thread to tickets. :thumbsup:

mike (infra): I'll follow the rebuild progress and post logs when ready.

aliya (billing): Thanks all — leaving billing followups to me.

jordan (on-call): Triage complete for now. Continuing monitoring.
